note: Case manifest for scripts/ui2-proof/capture.mjs. Every seed entry names its kind explicitly: 'engine_seed' = state this driver launches live through the plugin door (zero-token graphs; one real assistant turn for the card echo); 'historical_snapshot' = a pinned, already-committed run/session fixture read via the door's legacy-launch-root fallback (read-only, never relaunched). Adding a case ADDS A NEW TEST: a case naming a surface outside surfaces_registry fails exit 3 ('new test, not implemented') — the driver never fabricates an existing command. Baseline never captures synthesis/index.html or any file-openable RC: surfaces come from the real app renderer only.

baseline.description: Real-app proof of the three live surfaces of the actual React/SDK renderer: the ::workflow directive card in the message stream, the WORKFLOWS pane (run list + held-gate run detail), and the settings-gated live-run tray row. All state is engine-seeded into an isolated test runs root; nothing here is a CHATFRAME reconstruction.
